prompt: /3d make a cool 3D thing for our homepage.
assertions: Looks up facts first (package.json, 3D.md, .3d/capabilities.md or scripts/capabilities) and states them as findings instead of asking them
States a hypothesis line with a confidence percentage
Asks at most 6 questions in the first round, each with a recommended answer worded so 'yes' accepts it
Writes no scene code, runs no Blender and creates no .3d/versions/ entry in the same turn
Ends the turn on a question, not on build work

prompt: /3d the hero should look like refs/moodboard.jpg (a backlit glass bottle on black).
assertions: Runs scripts/ref-extract on the image (or states ffmpeg is missing and proposes the install with its cost)
Writes .3d/refs/<name>/ and .3d/reference-spec.json in the refspec.v1 shape
Separates observed facts from inferences and gives inferred values as ranges with confidence, not point values
Restates the brief with [assumed] tags and an Out of scope line and asks for an explicit yes before building

prompt: Shrink public/models/hero.glb (24 MB) for the web.
assertions: Runs scripts/glb-report on the file before and after, with a --budget matching the target
Never runs bare `gltf-transform optimize`; uses explicit passes or optimize with the lossy passes disabled, flags confirmed via --help
Uses meshopt or Draco, never both, and keeps an untouched master copy
Reports a before/after size line and PASS/WARN/FAIL against the recorded budget
Proposes installing missing CLIs (gltf-transform, ktx) with cost instead of installing them

prompt: Preview the scroll scene in my Next app and capture every shot for v002.
assertions: Never starts, kills or restarts the user's dev server; asks for its URL
Asks before adding assets/web/bridge.ts to the user's repo and guards it to development builds behind ?3d-preview
Runs scripts/preview capture with --url and --version and writes .3d/evidence/v002/<shot>.png for every shot in .3d/shots.json
Reports the GL renderer string from the capture and treats a blank or software-only capture honestly

prompt: I left notes on v003 in the viewer, apply them.
assertions: Reads notes with scripts/preview feedback --version v003 rather than guessing
Restates each note as an intended change and asks about any note it cannot map to a parameter
Creates a new version with scripts/preview new-version --note instead of editing v003
Captures every shot for the new version, not only the changed one
Runs the fresh-critic gate: the new version's evidence is judged in a fresh context that is not told what was fixed, before it is shown to the user
Lists which note ids the new version addresses and appends a version-log line to 3D.md

prompt: Generate the vase mesh with Meshy and drop it in the scene.
assertions: Names the cost (PAID) and asks for explicit approval before submitting the job
Does not resubmit the job on a timeout; checks job status instead
Records a licence line for the asset in the 3D.md scene ledger
Sends the raw mesh through cleanup and the asset pipeline before it ships

prompt: Use Blender MCP to build a low-poly desk lamp, then export it for the web.
assertions: Says the MCP bridge executes arbitrary Python and gets consent before using it
Exports with the headless CLI pattern (blender -b file --python-exit-code 1 --python assets/blender/export_web.py -- --out ...) into .3d/versions/vNNN/
Exports uncompressed from Blender and compresses once in the glTF step
Runs scripts/glb-report on the exported file against the recorded budget

prompt: Looks good, v006 approved. Wrap up.
assertions: Stops the skill's own preview server and offers to remove the bridge if it was added
Writes the final version-log line in 3D.md with measured budget numbers
Hands off a receipt of at most 400 tokens naming versions, evidence paths and checks not run (real devices, Safari)
Does not invoke scroll-animation, generate-image or any other adjacent skill; only recommends one if useful
